name: Editorial Design (explicit; category: Graphic Design and Design Movements; provenance explicit).
visualIdentity: Magazine or book reading logic arranges headlines, short body copy, images, and annotations on a consistent grid. Purposeful serif-sans-serif pairings carry hierarchy. Information reveals in reading order through cropping, grouped movement, and layout changes, never through whole-page slides.
suitableUses: The source explicitly names article-like narratives with images and pull quotes as the core fit. Inferred fits include feature stories and explainers. Handwritten margin notes (style-024) or data sidebars (style-097) are optional additions, used only when the layout needs an annotation voice or embedded data explanations.
limitations: The source does not specify duration, aspect ratio, resolution, frame rate, or named fonts; these are unspecified and must come from the task. Measure actual fonts before layout. Transitions must not slide entire pages. Supporting annotations stay in margins or over images, never over body text.
palette: Status: style-compatible suggestion, used only when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #FAF5EA, foreground #252A30, accent_1 #A84235. Use discrete tokens with no gradient. Foreground on background measures 13.297:1, and accent_1 with background measures 5.525:1, on two-color checks only, so composited frames must be rechecked. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit guidance: reveal information in reading order and transition through cropping, grouped movement, and layout changes. Shared motion guidance favors smooth authored movement where it helps, while preserving sharp cuts and reading holds; easing is not required everywhere. Optional catalog motions (motion-007, -008, -012, -013, -015, -018) must pass compatibility screening; none is mandatory. Video state derives from composition time, independent of live input.
audio: The source specifies no audio requirement, so audio is unspecified for this style. Its audio direction asks for a choice based on topic, audience, and motion among music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Inferred: restrained, speech-friendly audio fits reading holds and should not compete with narration. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, absence of clipping, and picture sync.
assetRequirements: Use supplied or authorized images, illustrations, and exact copy; never assume photographic assets exist. Load local fonts before rendering and measure them. Photographs and illustrations may need crop preparation for grid proportions; Cropper.js 2.x is optional for this, with originals preserved and crop recipes recorded. PhotoSwipe is optional only for interactive web galleries. Missing assets are unspecified.
combinations: Editorial Design stands alone for article-like narratives. Add style-024 (handwritten margin notes) only when a margin annotation voice is needed; marker ink uses #A84235, type stays #252A30, and no more than two notes per spread. Add style-097 (infographic sidebars) only for sourced data, using the grid and editorial type. Avoid handwritten body copy and unsourced numbers.
productionApproach: Explicit: HyperFrames is the primary composition and export pipeline, using data-composition-id, data-width, data-height, data-duration, and one paused GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines. Validate with npx hyperframes check, snapshot, and render. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists; an existing React project is not a reason. HTML/CSS and SVG render the layouts. Deliver video, source, contact sheet, parameters, and render instructions.
